children: Balchem reported third-quarter 2026 net sales of $290.7 million, up 8.6% year over year, and net earnings of $46.7 million, up 16.0%. Adjusted EBITDA rose 12.4% to $80.3 million, while adjusted diluted earnings per share increased to $1.57 from $1.35 a year earlier.
Revenue was $290.7 million, compared with $267.6 million in the prior-year quarter.
Gross profit was $105.7 million, and gross margin was 36.4%, up from 35.7% a year earlier.
Operating income was $62.4 million, compared with $54.6 million in the third quarter of 2025.
Net income was $46.7 million, versus $40.3 million in the prior-year quarter.
Adjusted diluted EPS was $1.57, compared with $1.35 a year earlier.
All three reporting segments recorded sales and operating income growth. Human Nutrition and Health sales were driven by higher demand in both nutrients and food ingredients and solutions.
Animal Nutrition and Health reported higher sales across monogastric and ruminant species markets; favorable mix supported segment performance, partly offset by higher manufacturing input costs.
Specialty Products sales growth reflected higher sales in the performance gases business.

Balchem plans to showcase Human Nutrition and Health innovations at SupplySide Global, including new science for VitaCholine, K2VITAL, Optifolin+ and OptiMSM, alongside performance nutrition and functional food and beverage applications.
The company repurchased approximately $28 million of common stock during the quarter and approximately $127 million over the trailing 12 months.
